title: Watch: Leapfrog Edge explained
summary: Watch: Leapfrog Edge Explained - The intuitive geostatistical software designed to integrate resource estimation directly with your geological model. Seamlessly transforming raw data into confident, visual estimates so you can go from geological interpretation to defensible decisions in a fraction of the time.
body_markdown:
**Understand the power of Leapfrog Edge!**


The intuitive geostatistical software that connects geological modelling directly to resource estimation. This transforms raw data into defensible, visual estimates so you can go from geological interpretation to confident decisions in a fraction of the time.
